items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Faith Malibu, he's one of the fellow.

ctx.x: I was raised on Mississippi River Tree, a camp in Missouri, right over there, but I never liked to swim. Some of those boats used to come to our town.
I just wondered if I ever heard you, maybe didn't know you in the old days. Faith Malibu. Yeah. Faith Malibu, he's one of the fellow. There's another Faith, too, that's in California.
You might have met him, a tall, light fellow, played trombone.
